strategy.overview: Lady Luck's safe scoring plan is to raise the spinner with the captive ball, then rip the spinner. The larger timed route completes A-K-Q-J-10 and the two star rollovers to start 10x playfield scoring; spelling P-O-K-E-R separately raises end-of-ball Bonus X.
strategy.simpleOverview: Hit the captive ball to raise the spinner, then shoot the spinner repeatedly. For a bigger but harder payoff, complete A-K-Q-J-10 and both stars to start timed 10x scoring. Spell POKER to raise Bonus X.
strategy.summary: Take one or more controlled captive-ball advances and grind the spinner; add the A-K-Q-J-10 and star sequence only when its target rebounds are manageable.

quickInfo.name: Raise Spinner
quickInfo.summary: Hit the captive ball; its value advances through visible steps.

quickInfo.name: Safe Route
quickInfo.summary: Repeat the spinner after its value is raised.

quickInfo.name: Start 10x
quickInfo.summary: Complete A-K-Q-J-10, then the two star rollovers.

quickInfo.name: Raise Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: Spell P-O-K-E-R in the top lanes.

steps.text: Hit the captive ball at least once to raise the spinner value.
Repeat the spinner while its return is controlled; the captive-ball value resets between balls.
When the card-target rebounds are safe, complete A-K-Q-J-10 and then both star rollovers to start timed 10x playfield scoring.
During 10x, rip the spinner or use the best repeatable lit shot until the timer expires.

alternatives.title: Bonus route
alternatives.when: Use this when the top lanes are feeding safely or the captive-ball rebound is dangerous.

steps.text: Spell P-O-K-E-R through the top lanes.
Repeat completions to raise end-of-ball Bonus X from 2x toward 5x.
Protect the multiplied bonus and avoid tilting at the drain.
Raise the spinner with controlled captive-ball hits.
Complete A-K-Q-J-10, then both star rollovers.
Shoot the spinner repeatedly during the short 10x timer.

machineSetup: Test the captive ball and spinner-value lamps, spinner switch, A-K-Q-J-10 target bank, both star rollovers, P-O-K-E-R lanes, Bonus X lamps, and Freeball Gate.
Confirm the captive-ball reset, 10x timer, Extra Ball and Special conversion, and tournament settings.

cautions.issue: Captive-ball progress resets between balls and 10x is a short timed window.
cautions.response: Finish the captive work and cash the spinner in the same ball; do not delay once 10x begins.
